faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Camwell's warranty.

questions.question: How long is the standard warranty?
questions.answer: Our standard warranty comes with 10 years of coverage for structural components and 5 years for moving parts.

questions.question: Can I extend my warranty after purchase?
questions.answer: Yes, you can upgrade to an extended warranty plan within 30 days of purchase date.

questions.question: Is the warranty transferable if I sell the property?
questions.answer: Yes, our warranty is fully transferable to new owners when property is sold.

questions.question: What is not covered by the warranty?
questions.answer: The warranty does not cover damage from misuse, natural disasters, or deliberate vandalism.

questions.question: How do I register my warranty?
questions.answer: All products are automatically registered at the time of installation, but you can ensure your information is recorded by filling out the online registration form.
